prompt:
High-fidelity mobile UI design comp: one portrait phone screen filling the frame. Crisp flat interface rendering, not a photograph and not a 3D render.

The app is Squirrel, a personal memory aid. This screen is its "chores" room, designed as a railway signal box interlocking lever frame seen straight on.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom:
1. A narrow header strip in very dark purple (#1b1030): a schematic track diagram of five short horizontal rail segments in a row, each with a small round lamp above and a tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace label below reading PILE, AGENDA, CHORES, TASKS, ASIDE. One lamp glows warm orange (#e66d0d), one glows pale cream (#fed6a7); the other three are dark and unlit.
2. A large enamelled signal-box nameplate: cream (#fdecd4) rounded rectangle, heavy near-black (#1c110b) 3px border, two small brass screw heads at its top corners. On it, tiny uppercase monospace reads "CHORES · SECTION 3 · ONE WAITING", and beneath that, in enormous condensed heavy uppercase grotesque, "WATER THE PLANTS".
3. The lower half is a frame of four full-height signal levers standing side by side: slim vertical painted steel bars, rounded knob at the top of each, heavy black outlines. Lever 1 is bright orange (#e66d0d) and is PULLED, leaning forward about 20 degrees. Levers 2 (violet #5e23b1) and 3 (dark brown #58413d) stand upright and are visibly LOCKED — a heavy black horizontal bar crosses each, and they are dimmed. Lever 4 is unpainted cream.
4. Under each lever a small cream enamel quadrant plate carries tiny uppercase monospace: DID IT, HOW OFTEN, STOP, SAY. Tiny lever numbers 1 2 3 4 below those.

MATERIALS: painted steel, vitreous enamel plates, brass screws, dark varnished frame. Ground is deep purple (#3b2560 into #2c1b48), a signal box interior at night, faint vertical panel lines.
STRICT PALETTE: #3b2560 #2c1b48 #1b1030 #e66d0d #fed6a7 #fdecd4 #1c110b #5e23b1 #58413d.
TYPE: heavy condensed industrial grotesque for the big legend; tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace for every machine label. Hierarchy by scale contrast alone.
MOOD: an operating machine — precise, warm, legible at arm's length. Absolutely not cosy, not hand-drawn, no mascot, no decorative gradients, no rounded friendly app shapes.
